svg.title: MAIB7002 Group Q: Fresh Food. Smarter Discounts.
svg.desc: Forecasting poster. The team-adopted equal RF and CatBoost blend reduces mean absolute prediction error by 8.56 percent against a seven-day average. No causal pricing or revenue benefit is claimed.
